```{r panel-description, echo=FALSE}
description <- "
Panel B: Ascending neuron variants create a spectrum of ppk23/ppk25 selectivity
================================================================================
Left:  Scatter plot of ppk23 vs ppk25 input to each AN09B017 variant (a-g),
       with diagonal = equal sensitivity. Points colored by dominant input.

Right: Bipartite connectivity diagram showing:
       ppk23 sensory -> AN09B017 variants -> mAL subtypes
       ppk25 sensory -> AN09B017 variants -> mAL subtypes
       GABAergic AN05B035 shown as red inhibitory edges.

Key finding: AN09B017 variants tile a spectrum from ppk23-selective (AN09B017b)
to ppk25-selective (AN09B017g), providing graded input to different mAL subtypes.
"

writeLines(description, file.path(pdir, "panel_B_description.txt"))
cat(description)
```

## Query AN09B017 connectivity from connectome

```{r an09b017-connectivity}
# AN09B017 variants
an09_types <- c("AN09B017a", "AN09B017b", "AN09B017c", "AN09B017d",
                "AN09B017e", "AN09B017f", "AN09B017g")

# ppk23/ppk25 sensory neuron types from shared setup
ppk23_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk23"]]
ppk25_types <- channel_neurons[["ppk25"]]

# Input-normalized weights: adj.matrix[pre, post] = fraction of post's total input
# Sum across all ppk23 sensory types for each AN09B017 variant
adj_rows <- rownames(adj.matrix)
adj_cols <- colnames(adj.matrix)

ppk23_to_an09 <- data.frame(
  post_type = an09_types,
  ppk23_input = sapply(an09_types, function(an) {
    ppk_in_mat <- ppk23_types[ppk23_types %in% adj_rows]
    if (length(ppk_in_mat) > 0 && an %in% adj_cols)
      sum(adj.matrix[ppk_in_mat, an])
    else 0
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ppk25_to_an09 <- data.frame(
  post_type = an09_types,
  ppk25_input = sapply(an09_types, function(an) {
    ppk_in_mat <- ppk25_types[ppk25_types %in% adj_rows]
    if (length(ppk_in_mat) > 0 && an %in% adj_cols)
      sum(adj.matrix[ppk_in_mat, an])
    else 0
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Merge
an09_inputs <- data.frame(type = an09_types, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(ppk23_to_an09, by = c("type" = "post_type")) %>%
  left_join(ppk25_to_an09, by = c("type" = "post_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    ppk23_input = replace_na(ppk23_input, 0),
    ppk25_input = replace_na(ppk25_input, 0),
    ratio = ifelse(ppk25_input > 0, ppk23_input / ppk25_input, Inf),
    dominant = case_when(
      ppk23_input > ppk25_input * 1.5 ~ "ppk23-biased",
      ppk25_input > ppk23_input * 1.5 ~ "ppk25-biased",
      TRUE ~ "balanced"
    ),
    label = sub("AN09B017", "", type)
  )

cat("AN09B017 input profiles:\n")
print(an09_inputs %>% select(type, ppk23_input, ppk25_input, ratio, dominant))
```

## Scatter plot: ppk23 vs ppk25 input to AN09B017 variants

```{r scatter, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
selectivity_colors <- c(
  "ppk23-biased" = "#FFD92F",
  "ppk25-biased" = "#E5C494",
  "balanced"     = "#999999"
)

p_scatter <- ggplot(an09_inputs, aes(x = ppk23_input, y = ppk25_input,
                                     color = dominant)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = selectivity_colors) +
  labs(x = "ppk23 input (fraction of total input)",
       y = "ppk25 input (fraction of total input)",
       color = "Selectivity") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig5_plot(p_scatter, "panel_B_an09b017_selectivity", width = 7, height = 7)
print(p_scatter)
```

## AN09B017 -> mAL connectivity

```{r an09-to-mal}
# Get AN09B017 -> mAL synaptic weights
an09_to_mal <- conn %>%
  filter(pre_type %in% an09_types, post_type %in% mal_subtypes) %>%
  group_by(pre_type, post_type) %>%
  summarise(weight = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("AN09B017 -> mAL connections:", nrow(an09_to_mal), "\n")
```

## Bipartite connectivity diagram

```{r bipartite, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Build bipartite network: sensory -> AN09B017 -> mAL
# Layer 1: ppk23/ppk25 (2 nodes)
# Layer 2: AN09B017 variants (7 nodes)
# Layer 3: mAL subtypes (15 nodes)

# Aggregate sensory -> AN09B017 edges
sensory_to_an09 <- bind_rows(
  ppk23_to_an09 %>% mutate(from = "ppk23") %>% rename(to = post_type, weight = ppk23_input),
  ppk25_to_an09 %>% mutate(from = "ppk25") %>% rename(to = post_type, weight = ppk25_input)
) %>% filter(weight > 0)

# Create edge list for bipartite
edges_l1_l2 <- sensory_to_an09 %>%
  mutate(layer = "sensory_to_relay",
         edge_color = ifelse(from == "ppk23", "#FFD92F", "#E5C494"))

edges_l2_l3 <- an09_to_mal %>%
  rename(from = pre_type, to = post_type) %>%
  mutate(layer = "relay_to_mAL",
         edge_color = "grey60")

# Also get AN05B035 -> AN09B017 (sign-inverting inhibitory connection)
sign_inverter <- conn %>%
  filter(pre_type == "AN05B035", post_type %in% an09_types) %>%
  group_by(pre_type, post_type) %>%
  summarise(weight = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(weight > 0)

if (nrow(sign_inverter) > 0) {
  cat("\nAN05B035 (GABAergic sign-inverter) connections:\n")
  print(sign_inverter)
}

# Build node positions for 3-layer layout
layer1_nodes <- c("ppk23", "ppk25")
layer2_nodes <- an09_types[an09_types %in% c(sensory_to_an09$to, an09_to_mal$pre_type)]
layer3_nodes <- sort(unique(an09_to_mal$post_type))

# Create igraph
all_edges <- bind_rows(
  edges_l1_l2 %>% select(from, to, weight, edge_color),
  edges_l2_l3 %>% select(from, to, weight, edge_color)
)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(all_edges, directed = TRUE)

# Assign layers
all_nodes <- V(g)$name
node_layer <- case_when(
  all_nodes %in% layer1_nodes ~ 1,
  all_nodes %in% layer2_nodes ~ 2,
  all_nodes %in% layer3_nodes ~ 3,
  TRUE ~ 2
)

# Manual layout: x = layer, y = evenly spaced within layer
layout_df <- data.frame(name = all_nodes, layer = node_layer, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
layout_df <- layout_df %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  mutate(y = seq(-n()/2, n()/2, length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()

layout_mat <- as.matrix(layout_df[match(V(g)$name, layout_df$name), c("layer", "y")])

# Node colors
node_colors <- case_when(
  V(g)$name == "ppk23" ~ "#FFD92F",
  V(g)$name == "ppk25" ~ "#E5C494",
  V(g)$name %in% an09_types ~ "#66C2A5",
  V(g)$name %in% mal_subtypes ~ "grey80",
  TRUE ~ "grey80"
)

# Edge widths proportional to weight
edge_widths <- scales::rescale(E(g)$weight, to = c(0.5, 4))

# Plot
png(file.path(panel_plot_dir("panel_B_bipartite", "png"), "panel_B_bipartite.png"),
    width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(g,
     layout = layout_mat,
     vertex.color = node_colors,
     vertex.size = ifelse(node_layer == 1, 15, ifelse(node_layer == 2, 10, 8)),
     vertex.label = V(g)$name,
     vertex.label.cex = 0.6,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.color = NA,
     edge.color = adjustcolor(E(g)$edge_color, alpha.f = 0.6),
     edge.width = edge_widths,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.3,
     edge.curved = 0.1)
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("ppk23", "ppk25", "AN09B017", "mAL"),
       fill = c("#FFD92F", "#E5C494", "#66C2A5", "grey80"),
       border = NA, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
dev.off()

# Also save PDF
pdf(file.path(panel_plot_dir("panel_B_bipartite", "pdf"), "panel_B_bipartite.pdf"),
    width = 12, height = 10)
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot(g,
     layout = layout_mat,
     vertex.color = node_colors,
     vertex.size = ifelse(node_layer == 1, 15, ifelse(node_layer == 2, 10, 8)),
     vertex.label = V(g)$name,
     vertex.label.cex = 0.6,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.frame.color = NA,
     edge.color = adjustcolor(E(g)$edge_color, alpha.f = 0.6),
     edge.width = edge_widths,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.3,
     edge.curved = 0.1)
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("ppk23", "ppk25", "AN09B017", "mAL"),
       fill = c("#FFD92F", "#E5C494", "#66C2A5", "grey80"),
       border = NA, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
dev.off()
```

## AN09B017 selectivity ratio bar chart

```{r ratio-bars, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
p_ratio <- ggplot(an09_inputs %>% filter(is.finite(ratio)),
                  aes(x = reorder(type, ratio), y = log2(ratio), fill = dominant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selectivity_colors) +
  labs(x = "AN09B017 variant",
       y = expression(log[2] * "(ppk23/ppk25 input ratio)"),
       fill = "Selectivity") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

save_fig5_plot(p_ratio, "panel_B_selectivity_ratio", width = 8, height = 5)
print(p_ratio)
```

## Panel narrative

```{r narrative, echo=FALSE}
n_variants <- nrow(an09_inputs)
n_ppk23_biased <- sum(an09_inputs$dominant == "ppk23-biased")
n_ppk25_biased <- sum(an09_inputs$dominant == "ppk25-biased")
n_balanced <- sum(an09_inputs$dominant == "balanced")
most_ppk23 <- an09_inputs$type[which.max(an09_inputs$ppk23_input)]
most_ppk25 <- an09_inputs$type[which.max(an09_inputs$ppk25_input)]
n_an09_mal_connections <- nrow(an09_to_mal)
n_mal_targeted <- length(unique(an09_to_mal$post_type))

n_sign_inverter <- nrow(sign_inverter)

narrative <- sprintf(
"PANEL B: The AN09B017 Relay -- Ascending Neuron Selectivity Spectrum
======================================================================

WHAT THIS PANEL SHOWS
---------------------
Left: Scatter plot of ppk23 vs ppk25 direct synaptic input (synapse count)
to each of the %d AN09B017 ascending neuron variants (a through g). Points
are colored by dominant input: ppk23-biased (gold), ppk25-biased (tan), or
balanced (grey). A diagonal line marks equal sensitivity.

Right: Log2 ratio bar chart (ppk23/ppk25 input ratio) for each variant,
quantifying the degree of selectivity.

Additionally, a 3-layer bipartite network diagram shows the full
ppk23/ppk25 sensory -> AN09B017 -> mAL connectivity architecture.

KEY OBSERVATIONS
----------------
1. The %d AN09B017 variants tile a selectivity spectrum: %d are ppk23-biased,
   %d are ppk25-biased, and %d are balanced.

2. %s receives the most ppk23 input; %s receives the most ppk25 input.

3. AN09B017 variants collectively contact %d mAL subtypes through %d
   individual connections, distributing sensory information non-uniformly
   across the mAL population.

4. %d connections from AN05B035 (GABAergic) to AN09B017 variants provide
   sign-inverting inhibition, which is the circuit basis for the ppk23
   sign reversal described in Panel C.

BIOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION
-------------------------
AN09B017 is not a single relay neuron but a family of variants with graded
ppk23/ppk25 selectivity. This means the ascending neuron layer does not
simply forward pheromone signals -- it decomposes the signal into a spectrum
of channel-specific streams. Each AN09B017 variant preferentially routes
one pheromone channel's information to specific mAL subtypes downstream.

The GABAergic AN05B035 sign-inverter adds a critical inhibitory branch:
ppk23 signals reaching AN09B017g through this pathway arrive with flipped
sign, creating the substrate for the F-selective mAL class.

PLACE IN THE FIGURE 5 STORY
----------------------------
Panel B explains HOW the sensory selectivity shown in Panel A is created.
The AN09B017 relay layer is the circuit mechanism that maps continuous
pheromone receptor activation into discrete mAL subtype channels. It sets
up Panel C's sign-reversal finding by showing the AN05B035 inhibitory
branch and connects to Panel G's mAL_m2a case study by showing which
AN09B017 variants provide its excitatory input.
",
n_variants,
n_variants, n_ppk23_biased, n_ppk25_biased, n_balanced,
most_ppk23, most_ppk25,
n_mal_targeted, n_an09_mal_connections,
n_sign_inverter
)

save_panel_narrative("panel_B", narrative)
cat(narrative)
```
